top_choice_rationale: P001 has the structure I trust: a quantitative 2011 prediction of flat bands at a magic angle (Bistritzer and MacDonald), an experiment seven years later (Jarillo-Herrero) finding correlated insulators and superconductivity where the theory pointed, and reproduction by many groups with several probes. The three-name allocation is stable across all supporters and the citation avoids the unresolved pairing mechanism. Andrei and Cao attribution remains a caveat to be checked by outside experts. P002 (optical lattice clock) is a mature, cross-checked instrument achievement I respect, but risks reading as continuation of the 2005 and 2012 metrology prizes, so I rank it second ahead of no award.
